cohort: 352 full-term newborns with body weight appropriate for gestational age, born by vaginal delivery or caesarean section, with Apgar Score > 7 at 5 min, and arterial cord blood gas analysis showing pH < 7.4 or BE <-8 mmol/l or lactate > 6 mmol/l
finding: Umbilical cord blood artery pH < 7.12 at birth was associated with respiratory distress syndrome in newborns.
